/**
 * The server session is the sole owner of the organization-entry label.
 * This helper only protects the display layer from an incomplete test double
 * or an older cached session; it never derives a label from roles or scope.
 */
export type OrganizationNavigationLabel =
  | 'My Team'
  | 'My Department'
  | 'My Unit'
  | 'My Area'
  | 'My Group'
  | 'My organization';

const KNOWN_LABELS = new Set<OrganizationNavigationLabel>([
  'My Team',
  'My Department',
  'My Unit',
  'My Area',
  'My Group',
  'My organization',
]);

export function normalizeOrganizationNavigationLabel(
  label: string | null | undefined,
): OrganizationNavigationLabel {
  return label && KNOWN_LABELS.has(label as OrganizationNavigationLabel)
    ? (label as OrganizationNavigationLabel)
    : 'My Unit';
}
